Explain and practise: git 1st

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
git version

git config --global user.name "our_username"

git config --global --list

notepad++

git config --global core.editor "notepad++.exe -multiInst -nosession"

git config --global --edit

git init GitDemo

ls -al

echo "Welcome to the version control" >> welcome.txt

ls -al

cat welcome.txt

git status

git add welcome.txt

git commit

git status

git pull origin master

git push origin master
